problem_restatement.input: The V58 authority-none cached observer epoch and its fixed-start 1440-minute candle-parity experiment.
problem_restatement.expected_output: A continuously advancing observer ledger with durable process-exit attribution and 1440 contiguous exact minutes across all eight assets.
problem_restatement.observed_output: The observer stopped after 793 contiguous exact minutes; its final persisted cycle contains three degraded public-L2 transport timeouts followed by one market_books row, with no later decision or heartbeat.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Preserve the failed epoch, prevent pooled attribution across its outage, and collect a new isolated 1440-minute authority-none parity window.

root_cause_assessment.verified_non_cause: Public-L2 transport timeouts alone do not terminate MultiAssetObserverRunner; they are caught as TransientCohortMarketDataError and emitted as degraded heartbeats.
root_cause_assessment.why_not_recoverable: The repaired process was not supervised by a durable exit-status recorder, its tmux session no longer exists, its output log is empty, no rebound STOP file exists, and the stale lock contains only the former PID.
root_cause_assessment.systemic_root_cause: A long-running research process and a fixed-start contiguity gate had no durable lifecycle supervisor or restart-safe epoch contract. Any unexplained process loss permanently caps the original gate even if the same run ID is resumed.
falsifiers: Durable exit telemetry proving a specific fatal exception, signal sender, or STOP-file transition would update the immediate-cause assessment.
A parity implementation that explicitly starts a new contiguous interval after a gap would update the claim that same-run resumption cannot advance this exact fixed-start gate.

validation_plan: Start the successor under a unique ledger root with no resume-run-id and confirm exactly one configuration identity and contiguous sequence.
Publish a separate checkpoint and separate fixed-start parity report; do not overwrite or pool the old epoch.
Require fresh 10/10 provider-symbol coverage and execution_authority none.
Retain the tmux pane on exit so a future termination has durable exit status, command identity, and log evidence.
Require 1440 contiguous minutes, 11520 exact OHLCV rows, zero unexplained mismatch, and exact route/profit-lock decision parity before any live cache proposal.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: The successor can encounter the same unknown external process loss.
Additional report-only public reads can contribute to shared-IP request pressure.
Candle equality alone does not prove route or profit-lock decision equality.
A clean successor window does not establish strategy profitability.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Start and technically accept the isolated successor observer epoch, then let its fixed-start 24-hour parity window mature while the live SP500 lifecycle remains independently monitored.
